snippet.title: Letters To Arralla | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Frosty Games Fest is proud to premiere an all-new gameplay trailer for Little Pink Clouds’ game of root booties and tuber tushies. Take a tour across the island of Arralla, meet its residents, see their homes and… open their mail?? You won’t have to wait for Australia Post to deliver this one – there’s a yam-spanking new demo available to download on Steam right now!

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2189310/Letters_To_Arralla/ 

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
